name: squad-skills
description: Role-specialized engineering squad skills for AI coding agents.

scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" build.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md "docs/**/*.md"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" build.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md "docs/**/*.md"
scripts.release:check: pnpm test && pnpm build && node scripts/check-release-readiness.ts && pnpm pack:check
scripts.test: pnpm type-check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm validate && pnpm skills:list
